messages:
alex: Quick sync — prioritization for next sprint: we need a clear decision on burst carryover, per-tenant quota slabs, and autoscale prewarm thresholds. Who's available?

mira: available. I think we should run a small carryover pilot (low risk) in Q2 to validate UX and ops.

jordan: agree with pilot. billing impact unclear if we allow cross-month carryover — need finance + billing input.

sam: can we reduce scope? pilot only for tenants with >= 4x monthly commit to avoid billing churn.

lina: ops concern: carryover + prewarm can create simultaneous reclaim spikes at boundary times. propose rate-limited reclaim and spread window.

alex: good call. proposal: carryover window = 24h, carryover cap = 30% of monthly headroom, reclaim uses control-plane rate limiter.

mira: implementation note: reclaim as token-bucket per-pool. sample config that should fit runtime: 
```
pool_reclaim:
  rate: 5/s
  burst: 20
```
This should be easy to expose in pool config.

jordan: autoscale prewarm policy: default = 'predictive' for committed tenants; 'on-demand' for others. Predictive requires historical traffic retention of 7d to be useful.

sam: quick finance check: 7d retention is fine for pilot; ballpark infra cost ~ $2k/mo.

lina: monitoring must include these SLOs: prewarm_fail_rate, latency_during_reclaim, cost_delta_per_tenant. Ops alert thresholds to follow.

alex: launch criteria proposal (for pilot -> alpha): 1) run pilot on 3 tenants, 2) prewarm fail rate < 2%, 3) billing events validated end-to-end, 4) ops runbook + rollback steps ready.

mira: ETA for infra work ~ 3 sprints. Could we compress to 2 sprints if we cut historical retention to 72h?

alex: tradeoff noted: drop to 72h retention for pilot (hybrid approach) to shorten ETA. Predictive quality may dip but acceptable for alpha.

jordan: customer asks: AcmeCorp and BetaCo asked for guaranteed burst during peak hours. We can offer a paid 'burst SLA' addon: soft-reserved tokens + preempt lower-tier background pools. Need clear preemption rules.

lina: preemption rules: use epoch-based slots, only preempt background non-committed work. Must avoid starving critical low-tier customers.

sam: pricing sketch: burst_SLA = +20% of dedicated base for guaranteed hours. Need ops to provide numeric thresholds (tokens/hr) to finalize.

alex: action items: @mira scope infra (carryover + token-bucket), @jordan define billing events and contracts, @lina create ops runbook skeleton and preemption rules, @sam update pricing draft and customer comms. Reconvene Thu 10:00am.

deploy-bot: Reminder — weekly deploy freeze Fri 22:00 UTC. Plan accordingly.

mira: noted. I'll post an infra PR with the reclaim config prototype by Wed EOD.

jordan: looping in billing team (cc: billing-eng). Will post required event schema in the thread.

lina: drafting oncall playbook and guardrails now; will add preemption simulation results next week.

sam: pricing draft located at /docs/pricing/burst-sla.md (WIP) — will share numbers by Tue.

alex: thanks all. Keeping this thread as canonical prioritization record for the sprint. :rocket:
